Usage: astryx doctor integration components [options] [package]

Check integration component names, replacements, and documented props

Arguments:
  package     Installed integration package name; omit to check the package in the current directory.

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  the check completed; component name conflicts, replaces findings for a package without the CLI range, props that differ from the code, and links that name no doc are warnings
  1  the integration is invalid, Core cannot be resolved, or a package that declares the CLI range has an invalid replaces

Examples:
  # Check the local integration
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 doctor integration components
  # Check an installed integration
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 doctor integration components @acme/widgets --json

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/doctor-integration-components
